note: The ONE carrier of the delivery verdict (t-305 N8; factory rules FR-13, FR-35, FR-59). The verdict is decided from TYPED records, never from the text of a reason: every record the delivery check collects carries a KIND (the producer fixes it), and `delivery_verdict.decide` reads `kinds[<kind>].verdict` - `no` when any kind says no or is not in this file (an unknown kind is never a pass), else `after_checks` when any kind says it, else `yes`. `ledger_states` and `trace_gaps` map a ledger row's state and a traceability gap word to a kind; an entry may be an object `{kind, needs}` when the kind depends on a fact outside the word (`env_decision`: the person's recorded word about a stand gap; `waiver_words`: a gate waiver with their words; `code_row`: a triage row code wrote and S7 can write again; `stand_word`: the person's recorded word `stand not confirmed`, so a test that changed after its run can only be run again elsewhere - the entry's `met` kind when it is recorded, its `kind` otherwise). `env_options` maps the closed answers of a stand-gap card (`question-vocabulary.json` `stand_gap_words`) to a kind. `owner` is a word of contract.DELIVERY_REASON_OWNERS (a test holds every owner to it). `words` hold the head sentence and the `delivery_ready:` line the report prints for each word; `{n}` is the number of items left with the person, `{reason}` the first reason. A kind that is added here and is not read by a producer changes nothing; a producer that names a kind that is not here gives `no`. `assert_stricter`: the triage found the assert stricter than the requirement by a control experiment; the person decides. Branch accounting (TQ1-20; `branch_accounting.delivery_records`): `branch_lost`, `branch_excluded`, `branch_unproven`, `branches_not_recorded`, `source_unreconciled` and `attachment_question_open` are debts the person can work off (`after_checks`, owner product); `branch_excluded_by_word` is a branch the person's confirmed answer left out (`none`: a named line in the report, no debt); `branches_unreadable` is the factory's own defect (`no`, owner factory, text starts `factory: `). Each is a separate kind (FR-35): lost and excluded are different work. The trace gap `question_open` (GW1-41, A3: a plan row that is `skip` or `unverifiable` and rests on a gate A question nobody has settled, or on one that could not be read) is an unconfirmed expectation, never a decision: the person answers the question, then the row stands or returns. `review_unverified_factory` (RN1-9): a test the code critic could not verify because the probe failed at the mutated line on a text the factory cannot read and no judgment proved it (E15, `cause: judgment`, unjudged or `cannot_judge`) - the person may still check it, the cause is the factory's. Proof strength (t-2181 §2.3, PC-5): `on_substitute` is a Then or a walked case a green run reached only through a side that was not `real` (the person re-runs it where the side is real; owner environment), `sides_unknown` one whose proof was run while the record of the sides could not be read (owner factory); both `after_checks`, never a pass. `placeholder_open` (t-2277 J-C7; `after_checks`, owner product - J-C5 makes the row legal only with `blocked_by: product`) is a Then whose green rests on an open first-look placeholder locator nobody settled with a run. Every `not_verified:*` ledger state needs its OWN exact `ledger_states` row: the prefix row `not_verified` reads `decided_elsewhere` (verdict `none`), so a state without its row counts as no debt (a test reads the ledger's constants). `awaiting_implementation` (`no`, owner product) is the ONE record of a story held for code (`contract.awaiting`): `awaiting_words` holds its words by the hold's `cause` (a cause the table lacks reads as `s5_absent_side`), and a stopped hold adds `stopped_suffix` and the person's words.
